description: BRIDGES is a dataset listed in State of Delaware open data portal (data.delaware.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Delaware. This data comes directly from TSDM so changes are reflected when they are posted in TSDM. Coverage: Delaware. The table has 57 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-delaware-gov-portal.
